scope: Throughput and execution qualification; no new full-budget learning results.

1.includes: process startup, replay prefill, warmup, two timed runs and teardown

limitations: Pipeline throughput repeats use one seed and Pong; environment-only checks for the other games are one measurement each.
Native ALE preprocessing and resets differ from Gymnasium wrappers; scores must be measured with the matching checkpoint protocol.
Private replay RNG changes the random stream; vector DQN changes action/update ordering even when update counts are preserved.
Joint PPO samples one task per complete rollout; 16 environments double rollout size and are a separate profile.
Joint random task budgets are recorded per game; equal per-game budgets with sequential protocols are not assumed.
Scheduling measurement covers two short DQN jobs, not an entire teaching matrix or cold compiler-cache startup.
GPU memory values are PyTorch allocator peaks, not total device usage; parent RSS excludes environment worker RSS.
No target-score wall time, final learning quality, or GPU-utilization improvement is claimed.
